name: Oceanographic Museum
kicker: The marine museum at Cầu Đá
summary: Marine museum at Cầu Đá: walk the tanks and specimen halls for 90 to 120 minutes of the city’s sea life. The fisheries service dates from 1922, and the museum from 1923. Hours are 06:00–18:00 and also 07:30–17:00. An adult ticket is about 40,000 VND.
dotReason: A museum hour on the south beach road, beside a boat day, not the sand itself.
getThere: 01 Cầu Đá, on the south beach road.
heroCaption: The institute front, with both museum signs above the stairs

notice.body: Hours are 06:00–18:00 and also 07:30–17:00. An adult ticket is about 40,000 VND and can change.

body: The Oceanographic Museum is the public hall of the Institute of Oceanography at 01 Cầu Đá. Give the tanks, the specimen rooms, and Trường Sa park in the same grounds 90 to 120 minutes. The fisheries service dates from 14 September 1922, and the marine-biology museum from the year after that.

The tanks hold more than 300 marine species. The collection is about 23,000 samples from about 5,000 species, in exhibition space of about 5,000 m². The museum receives hundreds of thousands of visits a year. Hours are 06:00–18:00 every day, including holidays, and also 07:30–17:00. The usual adult price is about 40,000 VND.

figures.caption: The stairs and the institute sign, from the front path
figures.alt: The front of the Institute of Oceanography in Nha Trang, with the museum sign above the door

gettingThere: The museum is at 01 Cầu Đá, the south end of the beach road, the same port as the Hòn Mun boat. An address line also lists 89 Trần Phú. Use 01 Cầu Đá.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Follow the beach road south to Cầu Đá. The museum is the shuttered building with the institute name over the stairs.

legs.heading: From the Hòn Mun boat
legs.body: The 45-minute reef boat leaves this port. See the museum before you board, or after you land.

admissionNote: About 40,000 VND for an adult, and the price can change. About 20,000 VND for a student, 10,000 VND for a pupil, and free under 6. Trường Sa park, in the same grounds, uses the same ticket.
